You're talking about 500 watts or so, about 2/3 HP. Hard to power something like that for very long with an off-the-shelf battery. You could buy a big UPS box, say Cyber Power or APC. Or if you like tinkering, four car batteries and a 500-watt inverter would do the trick. Better would be a portable generator, say a Honda, one with an electric starter. If you have somewhere outdoors you can site it, would be cheaper and more reliable, and would run for longer.
